name: Pierre Dominique Ostrowski
headline: Helping companies to grow and last
summary:
Hello, I'm Pierre, Managing Partner of Zebra Embassy, a boutique startup consulting firm that believes in sustainable and socially responsible growth for startups and scaleups in Germany. We are proud to promote the values of the Zebra movement, and we offer diverse expertise ranging from Finance, Legal, Tech, and Marketing to help companies navigate complex processes such as building growth engines, hardware production planning, and applying for R&D grants.

Our team has years of experience in the startup and scaleup space, and we understand the challenges these companies face in a fast-paced and competitive environment. We take pride in fostering a collaborative and diverse startup ecosystem in Germany, and our values are reflected in our approach to consulting. Our number one mantra within our company is "always be helpful", and we are determined to create an environment that encourages innovation and collaboration.

If you are a startup or scaleup looking to break new ground and proactively shape the future, we are here to help. We offer a personalized approach tailored to your specific needs, and we are committed to making the process as simple and successful as possible. Join us in promoting sustainable and socially responsible growth. Let's work together to build a more equitable and prosperous future for everyone.

positions.title: Managing Partner
positions.description: As the Managing Partner of Zebra Embassy, I lead a team of experts who specialize in helping startups and scaleups to navigate complex processes such as building growth engines, hardware production planning, and applying for R&D grants. Our diverse expertise in Finance, Legal, Tech, and Marketing enables us to provide personalized consulting services tailored to our client's specific needs. We take pride in promoting sustainable and socially responsible growth for our clients and fostering a collaborative and diverse startup ecosystem in Germany.

positions.title: Chief Marketing Officer
positions.description: As the first senior hire with the Carly team, I championed organizational development and forged an explosive and profitable growth architecture that increased not only revenue but also contribution margins, while improving customer experience. Leveraging comprehensive marketing and business strategies, I contributed to Carly’s dominating position within the automotive consumer software space, focusing on promoting transparency in the car ownership lifecycle.

positions.title: Marketing & Growth Consultant
positions.description: As an independent marketing and growth consultant, I advise and support talented teams of consumer businesses. With clients, I work strategically on how to build powerful digital brands, thriving communities, and deep customer relationships. As a full-stack marketer, I also support operationally with profitable user acquisition, funnel optimization, churn prevention, and growth management.

positions.title: Vice President of Marketing
positions.description: Serving as the VP of Marketing, I was the driving force behind the transformation of a niche fitness app into a mass-marketing lifestyle brand through award-winning creative campaigns and highly profitable quantitative marketing. As one of the first employees, I was fully responsible for all marketing initiatives on an operative and strategic level. I successfully built and led a high-capacity, >35-member team with 5 direct reports through an explosive growth phase of the organization.

positions.title: Chief Marketing Officer
positions.description: As the first employee and Chief Marketing Officer at UNU, I initiated the strategic and operational marketing efforts for market entry, the brand concept, and the campaign to sell the very first batch of electric scooters.

positions.title: Entrepreneur in Residence
positions.description: As an EiR, I supported the founders of the venture Miflora with identifying market expansion and business development opportunities. Amongst other things I facilitated a Mother’s Day campaign and its marketing strategy and secured a six-figure revenue deal as a co-op partner with a big german media house.

company.description:
Who We Are: 
At Zebra Embassy, we empower startups and scale-ups in Germany to grow sustainably and operate efficiently. Inspired by the Zebra Movement, we believe business success should merge profitability with positive impact.

What We Do:
We help companies get 35% of their R&D costs back!
Our core expertise lies in public funding: we’ve already helped 250+ clients secure over €100 million in non-dilutive financing through the German Research & Development tax incentive and other funding programs. From strategy to execution, we make sure innovative companies get the support they deserve.

How We Work:
We’re more than consultants, we’re partners. Most of us have founded companies ourselves, so we know first-hand how crucial time and funding are. That’s why we deeply identify with the challenges founders face and can support startups with real empathy and practical experience. With deep expertise, hands-on support, and a passion for entrepreneurship, we simplify complex processes so founders can focus on what matters most: building great companies.

Why Zebra Embassy:
Because we share your ambition. We’re convinced that the future belongs to companies that grow responsibly, balancing financial performance with social good.

Curious how much funding your startup could unlock? Let’s talk.
